exposure: severity of birth asphyxia (HIE I, HIE II, HIE III)
cohort: The study included 150 asphyxiated neonates admitted to the NICU of a department of pediatrics.
finding: Neonates who experience birth asphyxia develop hypocalcemia and hypoglycemia after delivery, with the severity of asphyxia directly correlating to the extent of these conditions.
